message.content:
It depends on whether you’re talking about **deserts** (the dry landscapes) or **desserts** (sweet foods).

| Topic | Typical Colors |
|-------|----------------|
| **Desert landscape** | Sand‑tan, ochre, pale gold, dusty orange, muted browns – basically all the warm, earthy tones you see when you look at dunes or rocky plains. |
| **Dessert food** | Anything goes! Chocolate cakes bring deep chocolatey browns, fruit tarts add bright reds, oranges, yellows, berries give purples/pinks, custards are creamy whites/cream, ice cream comes in pastel shades, etc. |

If you had a specific dessert in mind—say “chocolate mousse” or “fruit tart”—let me know and I’ll tell you its characteristic hue(s)!
